purpose: Make the reviewed frontier-data findings executable as shared requirements for source manifests and bounded data studies across pretraining, mid-training and post-training.
evidence_boundary: This contract changes experiment metadata and admission requirements only. It does not admit a source, set mixture weights, authorize acquisition or change the 5,000-GPU-hour allocation.

manifest_schema.quality_vector: Record the component scores, calibration/version and retained score distribution; a publisher score or one scalar cutoff is insufficient.
manifest_schema.dependency_metadata: For long-context or repository-event records, record related-item identities, dependency type and an auditable dependency-distance value; use null with a reason when unavailable.
manifest_schema.lineage: Derived records bind source identities, transformation type, teacher/generator identity, generation settings and rejection reasons.
manifest_schema.trajectory_metadata: Agent records bind episode, task, repository snapshot, environment image, tool schema, turn, branch, outcome, recovery labels and per-segment loss masks.

bank_boundaries.rule: Natural source records remain identifiable and are not merged with generated rewrites.
Source-grounded rewrites, learning notes and QA retain source context and independent fidelity checks.
Generated reasoning or solutions remain a separate family with teacher and correctness evidence.
Issues, reviews, pull requests, commits, diffs and tests retain repository/event links and behavioral checks.
Tool/environment trajectories retain schemas, turn order, observations, outcomes and recovery cases.

sampling_policy.method: Calibrated quality-weighted sampling with explicit coverage constraints.
requirements: Report score and exposure distributions by coverage stratum.
Do not use a universal hard cutoff without measuring lost coverage.
Count retained stock, eligible unique tokens and sampled exposure separately.
Any repeated exposure declares unique tokens, passes and repetition count.

pretraining.default: Mostly natural, quality-weighted coverage with source-specific extraction.
measure: token utility per unique and exposed token

capability_mid_training.default: Targeted repository, code, math, repair, tool-use and executable workflow data; grounded or executable supervision is admitted only with environment, outcome and loss-mask evidence.
measure: capability per continuation token and GPU-hour
tool-call validity, recovery and long-horizon coherence
downstream SFT convergence and early RL adaptation

context_extension.default: Prefer records with explicit distant dependencies over length-only documents.

post_training.default: Select supervised, rollout and self-distillation data by independently verified outcomes and reward reliability.

cross_stage_controls: Benchmark decontamination is an independent gate from exact, fuzzy and semantic deduplication.
Proxy-study rankings require matched-exposure confirmation on held-out families before production claims.
Frontier-reported mixture percentages, token totals and teacher pipelines are directional evidence only and are not copied.
Multimodal data remains outside the first text-only release.
admission_boundary: A launch manifest must bind this contract, all required fields, five source-readiness gates, disjoint evaluation families and measured cost. This contract alone never authorizes training.
